description: Update an existing Monitor Status in OneUptime. Only include the fields you want to change - unspecified fields will remain unchanged. Use get_monitor_status afterwards to see the updated record.

color.description: Color of this resource in Hex (#32a852 for example).

description.description: Friendly description that will help you remember.
description.example: This is an example of longer text content that might be stored in this field.

id.description: The unique identifier (UUID) of the Monitor Status to update. Required. Use list_monitor_statuses to find IDs.

isOfflineState.description: Is this monitor in offline state?

isOperationalState.description: Is this monitor in operational state?

name.description: Any friendly name of this object.

priority.description: Where this status sits in the project's list of monitor statuses, from the healthiest (the lowest number) down to the worst: where monitors are shown together, as on a status page or in a monitor group, the status furthest down the list wins. A new status without a number goes just above the offline status. Setting a number moves the status to that place, and the ones in between shift by one. In the dashboard, drag the rows to reorder them.

name: update_monitor_status
title: Update Monitor Status
